def factor_vol_anomaly_reversal_ema(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    atr_pct = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    ema_short = atr_pct.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5).mean()
    ema_long = atr_pct.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    anomaly = (ema_short / ema_long.replace(0.0, np.nan)) - 1.0
    ret5 = df_copy["close"].pct_change(5)
    factor = -ret5 * anomaly
    df_copy["factor_vol_anomaly_reversal_ema"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_vol_anomaly_reversal_ema"]
description: Preserves the core volatility shock reversal mechanism from the qualified parent: when short-term normalized ATR is elevated relative to its long-term average, recent price declines may reverse. The lightweight modifier from the secondary parent replaces simple rolling means with exponential moving averages (span 5 and 20) for computing the ATR ratio. EMA gives more weight to recent observations, providing a more responsive and stable volatility regime detector. Aims to preserve parent RankICIR strength while improving signal smoothness and MI.
